$comment: Studio section of the cross-platform backup zip. Recomputed by scripts/lib/studio-backup-reference.mjs in scripts/studio-contracts-check.mjs. Local rows use epoch-millisecond times (iOS / Android storage form; Web converts with toISOString). iOS has one database per account: seed rows whose accountPartition is not seed.partition, and assets only they reference, are not inserted there; iOS drops those ids from the expected lists too (expected assetIds include 4D…0006, referenced only by uid-b). Expected updatedAt is epoch milliseconds (Web compares Date.parse of its ISO value). Placeholders: $seed / $empty = the local states below; $export = exportCase.expect.studio or.entries; $exportLower = the same studio with every id except assetId lowercased; $exportWithoutA2 = export entries minus the original entry of asset 4D…0002.

rules: data.studio is written only when the current partition has at least one non-deleted work; then BackupFile.version = 2, otherwise the file is byte-for-byte the version-1 format.

Readers accept version <= 2; above that the whole import is rejected (version_too_new). A file without data.studio leaves local works, rounds, versions, refs and their assets untouched in every import mode.

Exported scope: non-deleted works of the current partition; their rounds whose status is in exportedRoundStatuses; versions and roundRefs of those rounds; assets = distinct assetId of those versions and refs whose original bytes exist locally.

Row shape: exactly spec.fields per table, every field present (null when absent; readers accept null in every field and fill their own NOT NULL defaults); UUID-shaped work / round / version / chat ids uppercase, other strings verbatim, assetId verbatim (image-store key, case-sensitive; asset 4d…0001 is lowercase); times ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds; presetIds / params / modelRef / adjustments as JSON values, not strings; arrays sorted by primary key ascending in UTF-16 code-unit order, case-sensitive (roundRefs by roundId then order).

asset.mime = mime of the lowest-id version using that asset, else the sniffed mime of the original bytes, else application/octet-stream (never null). Entries: original studio-assets/<assetId>, thumbnail studio-assets/<assetId>.thumb (assetId verbatim) (only when stored locally); both recorded in attachmentChecksums under the full entry name.

Import, importNew and merge: a backup work whose id already exists in the current partition (tombstone included) is skipped with all its rounds, versions, refs and assets. Otherwise the work and its rounds / versions / refs are written with accountPartition = current partition, baseRevision = 0, syncState = pending, other fields as in the backup.

Import, replaceAll with data.studio: all works of the current partition (tombstones included) and their child rows are deleted first, then every backup work is written as above. Asset ids of deleted rows are handed to the orphan sweeper purge after commit (it rechecks every studio and chat reference); never delete them directly.

Assets: an asset already stored locally is kept as is. Otherwise its original is written when the entry exists, and its thumbnail when the .thumb entry exists, else ensureThumbnail runs after the rows commit. A missing original leaves the rows written.
All studio rows of one import are committed in one database transaction; assets written by this import are deleted again if that transaction fails.

Any import mode (v1 or v2) must not remove assets still referenced by studio rows: image cleanup after a conversation replaceAll goes through the orphan sweeper purge, not a direct delete or a whole-directory swap.

importCases.note: Backup without studio section: local works, rounds and assets untouched in every mode, replaceAll included.
Fresh device restore; A4 has no thumbnail entry so it is regenerated.
Same work id already in this partition (tombstone included): whole work skipped, local row kept.
Partition works replaced; old assets go to the orphan sweeper, which keeps A1 (new W1) and A9 (chat) and purges A10; other partition untouched.
Work / round / version ids read case-insensitively and stored uppercase; assetId (and entry names) kept verbatim.
Original entry missing: rows still written, asset not written, no thumbnail work for it.
fileVersion above maxReadable rejects the whole import before any write.
